content: संरभ् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To become agitated, be overwhelmed or affected. .²2 To be exasperated or furious, be enraged or irritated (mostly in {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%}); संरब्धसिंहप्रहृतं वहन्ति <ls>R. 16. 16</ls>. .²3 To seize, catch hold of (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²4 To fear; प्रवृत्तं रज इत्येव तन्न संरभ्य चिन्तयेत् <ls>Mb. 12. 194. 32</ls>.
